description: Call ANY Placetel Web API v2 endpoint directly (covers the full API surface, 124 endpoints). Required: method (GET|POST|PUT|DELETE), path (with leading slash, e.g. '/calls', '/contacts/123'). Optional: body (object), query (object → query string). Use the named placetel_* tools for the common resources; use this for anything else. Secrets stay server-side.

body.description: JSON request body sent to the API

method.description: HTTP method: GET, POST, PUT or DELETE

path.description: Placetel API v2 path with leading slash, e.g. '/calls'

name: placetel_request
